中心 $v$ цурав
.compile
.Compile the code below to add up the numbers in a given list, excluding any numbers that are divisible by a given prime number.
# Define a list of numbers
numbers_list = [2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13]
# Define a prime number
prime_number = 3
# Initialize a variable to store the sum
sum = 0
# Loop through the list of numbers
i=0
while i < len(numbers_list):
    # If the number is not divisible by the prime number, add it to the sum
    if numbers_list[i] % prime_number != 0:
        sum += numbers_list[i]
    i += 1
# Print the sum of the numbers
